framework_lessons: Trace financing incentives and forced sellers.
assessment: The Terra run mechanism is the standout successful warning, although the simultaneous relative preference for Terra is a major contradictory investment conclusion. Energy-capital discipline and SLB operating recovery have concrete support. Several broad bullish allocations lack deadlines; they should not inflate either hits or misses. The analysis correctly treats recession signals as conflicting, but often extends descriptive institutional differences into unmeasured claims about investment quality.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
